groups.defect: isAccessTokenId extracts the grant shortcut at the wrong offset and inverts the equality check; it also lacks a prefix-length guard, allowing short prefixes to throw.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same offset and polarity errors in the matcher. s_271c9373 additionally reports the short-prefix exception, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: AccessTokenContext checks grantType twice instead of checking rawTokenId, allowing null raw token IDs.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same incorrect argument in the constructor's fourth null check. Changing that argument resolves every report.

groups.defect: The documented and unvalidated grant-shortcut length conflicts with the decoder's fixed two-character requirement; the decoder also rejects colon-containing IDs with non-six-character prefixes instead of applying UNKNOWN/legacy handling.
groups.rationale: All three report the same shortcut-length contract mismatch, pointing at either its documentation or the decoder. s_07f54fcf additionally reports inconsistent fallback handling for IDs from other encoder deployments.
